meta.name: swiftui-performance-audit
meta.description: Audit and improve SwiftUI runtime performance from code review and architecture. Use for requests to diagnose slow rendering, janky scrolling, high CPU/memory usage, excessive view updates, or layout thrash in SwiftUI apps, and to provide guidance for user-run Instruments profiling when code review alone is insufficient.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 诊断并优化 SwiftUI 应用运行时性能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在开发 SwiftUI 应用并遇到渲染慢或内存高的问题。
copy.tagline_en: Diagnose and optimize SwiftUI app runtime performance
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are developing a SwiftUI app and facing slow rendering or high memory usage.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会分析你提供的 SwiftUI 代码，找出导致界面卡顿、滚动不流畅、CPU/内存占用高等性能问题的原因，并给出修复建议。如果代码分析不够，它还会指导你用 Instruments 工具做性能剖析。
howto.when: 当你询问 SwiftUI 应用出现渲染慢、滚动卡顿、CPU/内存高、视图更新过多或布局抖动等问题时触发。

say.text: 我的 SwiftUI 列表滚动很卡，能帮我看看代码吗？
say.note: Claude 会分析代码中的性能问题。

say.text: 这个视图 CPU 占用太高，怎么优化？
say.note: Claude 会检查代码并给出优化建议。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude will analyze your SwiftUI code to identify causes of performance issues like slow rendering, janky scrolling, high CPU/memory usage, and excessive view updates, then suggest fixes. If code review is insufficient, it will guide you to profile with Instruments.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about SwiftUI app performance issues such as slow rendering, janky scrolling, high CPU/memory, excessive view updates, or layout thrash.

say_en.text: My SwiftUI list is scrolling very slowly, can you check the code?
say_en.note: Claude will analyze the code for performance issues.

say_en.text: This view has high CPU usage, how can I optimize it?
say_en.note: Claude will review the code and suggest optimizations.
